topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: The air has changed. The boundary we once shared, now whispers of division. They gather materials, these tall, rigid forms that speak of barriers. I watch from a distance, the familiar paths and the spaces we've known no longer feel the same. The forest, once open, cradles a new quiet, a pause that lingers. Shadows grow longer where the sun used to play freely. The scent of the earth, my earth, is muffled now. The motion of the leaves seems to slow, as if the trees, too, have noticed the shift. I move cautiously, every step a question, each breath a longing for what was.
